# Motif track report

Generated 2026-10-29 by `tools/motifs.py` from 1609 tagged units and 11278 motifs in use.

Weights: a motif found in fewer units counts for more (log N/df). The tags themselves are a reader's interpretation. Units marked *original* are tagged from the Arabic or Hebrew text in this repo; the others are tagged from secondary knowledge until their texts are added.

Benchmarks check the matching machinery, not discovery: these parallels were known when the units were tagged.

| 6.7 | Israel's covenant and twelve chiefs; the Christians' forgotten portion ↔ 'God's hand is fettered'; the blessings of observing the Torah | God cast enmity and hatred among them until the day of resurrection (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Israel's covenant and twelve chiefs; the Christians' forgotten portion ↔ Against the deification of Jesus; the weeping Christians | Those who say 'God is the Messiah son of Mary' have disbelieved (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Judging by the Torah, the Gospel and the Quran; eye for eye ↔ Life like withering plants; the Garden as wide as heaven and earth; every calamity written; iron sent down; Jesus' followers and invented monasticism | Jesus was given the Gospel (Injīl), confirming the Torah before it (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Against the deification of Jesus; the weeping Christians ↔ Life like withering plants; the Garden as wide as heaven and earth; every calamity written; iron sent down; Jesus' followers and invented monasticism | Christians are nearest in affection to the believers because they have priests and monks and are not proud (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Questions not to ask; the freed camels of the pagans ↔ The hanif creed and patience | Whoever is guided is guided for his own good; whoever strays strays against himself (6.7) |

| 6.7 | Darkness and light, clay and two terms, and those who would not believe ↔ The Book made firm, the Throne on the water, the challenge of ten surahs | Deniers demand that a treasure be sent down to the prophet or an angel come with him (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Mercy written on himself; the idolaters' denial at the gathering ↔ Tenfold reward; my life and death for God; no bearer bears another's burden | The Prophet is commanded to be the first of those who submit (awwal al-muslimīn) (6.7) |
| 6.7 | The Prophet consoled; a ladder to the sky; animals as communities ↔ Noah, the boiling oven, the lost son and al-Judi | The prophet disclaims having God's treasuries, knowing the unseen, or being an angel (6.7) |

| 6.7 | Sworn oaths for a sign; even the dead speaking would not convince ↔ Eat what God's name is spoken over; the opened breast; jinn and humans judged | Every prophet has enemies: devils of humans and jinn inspiring one another with gilded speech (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Eat what God's name is spoken over; the opened breast; jinn and humans judged ↔ Life like a crop, the abode of peace, darkened faces | Paradise as the abode of peace (dār al-salām) (6.7) |

| 6.7 | Salih, Thamud and the she-camel ↔ Deaf and dumb beasts, heart and trial | The arrogant elite confront the weak (mustad'afun) who believed the prophet (6.7) |

| 6.7 | The unlettered prophet foretold in Torah and Gospel ↔ Recite the Book; dispute with the People of the Book; the unlettered prophet | The awaited messenger is 'the unlettered prophet' (al-nabi al-ummi) (6.7) |

| 6.7 | The disavowal - treaties, sacred months and asylum ↔ Twelve months and the ban on intercalation | Four of the twelve months are sacred (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Who maintains the mosques; God above family ↔ Hypocrites who mock and the destroyed peoples | God's good pleasure (ridwan) is greater than the gardens of Eden (6.7) |

| 6.7 | Prayer in distress, a changed Quran, the storm at sea ↔ Stand firm; prayer times; good deeds remove bad | Humankind was originally one community, then they differed (6.7) |
| 6.7 | A messenger for every nation; no ransom ↔ Legends of the ancients, the fallen roof, the angels who take souls (Surah 16:24-50) | Every nation has a messenger, and it is judged justly when he comes (6.7) |

| 6.7 | Joseph and his brothers (Surah 12, full read) ↔ Abraham's guests and the destruction of Lot's people (Surah 15:51-77) | Do not despair of God's mercy (rawh / rahma); only unbelievers or the astray despair (6.7) |
| 6.7 | Joseph and his brothers (Surah 12, full read) ↔ Daughters of God, all things glorify him, bones and dust, the cursed tree (Surah 17:40-60) | Satan stirs up enmity (nazagha) between brothers or among people (6.7) |

| 6.7 | Ashes in the wind, Satan disowns his followers, the good and bad tree (Surah 14:18-34) ↔ The command has come; cattle, rain, sea and stars as blessings (Surah 16:1-23) | If you counted God's blessings you could never number them (6.7) |
| 6.7 | The guarded reminder, the guarded heaven and the fertilizing winds (Surah 15:1-25) ↔ The jinn hear the recitation | Jinn or devils who used to sit listening at heaven's gates now find it full of stern guards and shooting stars (shuhub) lying in wait (6.7) |

| 6.7 | The command has come; cattle, rain, sea and stars as blessings (Surah 16:1-23) ↔ Those whose works are weightless; the sea as ink (Surah 18:102-110) | Your God is one God (ilahukum ilahun wahid) (6.7) |

## Unmatched motifs: search targets

Motifs found in only one unit. For units read from their original text, these are the details no other tagged text shares yet, so they are the places to look next (rabbinic, Syriac, apocryphal and other literature).

**Creation in six days and the seventh-day rest**
- Light exists before the sun and moon are made (Gen 1:3, Gen 1:16)
- Deity gives names to the elements it creates (day, night, heaven, earth, seas) (Gen 1:5, Gen 1:8, Gen 1:10)
- The earth itself is commanded to bring forth plants or animals (Gen 1:11, Gen 1:12, Gen 1:24)
- Humans and animals originally given only plants as food (Gen 1:29, Gen 1:30)
- Deity rests on the seventh day after creating, and sanctifies it (Gen 2:2, Gen 2:3)

**Second creation account, Eden, and the making of woman**
- A mist or spring rises from the earth to water the ground (Gen 2:6)
- The first human is put in the garden to work and guard it (Gen 2:15)
- Eating the forbidden fruit is threatened with death (Gen 2:17)

**The serpent, the eating, the curses and the expulsion**

- Each accused shifts blame to another (man to woman, woman to serpent) (Gen 3:12, Gen 3:13)
- Woman punished with pain in childbirth and subordination to husband (Gen 3:16)

- Murderer condemned to be a restless wanderer, the ground withholding its yield (Gen 4:12, Gen 4:14)

**Birth of Seth and Enosh; calling on the name of the LORD**
- A new son given in place of one who was killed (Gen 4:25)

**Sons of God, daughters of men, and the Nephilim**

**The Flood (full read)**

- Vessel has several decks, a side door and a roof opening or window (Gen 6:16, Gen 8:6, Gen 8:13)
- Clean animals taken aboard by sevens, unclean by pairs (Gen 7:2, Gen 7:3, Gen 7:8)
- Seven days pass between the warning or boarding and the onset of the flood (Gen 7:4, Gen 7:10)

- A raven is sent out and does not return (goes to and fro) (Gen 8:7)
- A dove returns with an olive leaf in its beak (Gen 8:11)

**Blessing of Noah, blood laws and the covenant of the bow**

- God sees the bow in the cloud and remembers his covenant (the sign reminds the deity) (Gen 9:15, Gen 9:16)
